4. KEMUDAHAN PERUBATAN:

Rawatan pesakit luar percuma bagi Pengerusi, Timbalan Pengerusi,
ahli-ahli, isteri-isteri dan anak-anak mereka tetapi jika masuk hospital
bayaran harian wad yang kena dibayar mengikut kadar yang kena di-
bayar bagi pegawai-pegawai Bahagian I kecuali jika masuk hospital
adalah akibat kecederaan yang dialami dalam menjalankan tugasnya.
Jika Pengerusi atau ahli-ahli adalah seseorang yang telah berpencen
ia boleh memilih untuk mendapatkan kemudahan perubatan yang
disediakan untuk orang-orang berpencen. "Anak" ertinya anak tang-
gungan Pengerusi atau ahli yang berumur di bawah 21 tahun, atau
mana-mana anak tanggungan yang mengikuti ijazah pertama dalam'
sesuatu institusi pengajian tinggi dan termasuklah seseorang anak yang
cacat otak atau cacat anggota yang mengenainya had umur tidak dipakai.
Ianya hendaklah juga termasuk seseorang anak tiri atau anak yang di-
ambil sebagai anak angkat di bawah mana-mana undang-undang atau
adat yang diiktirafkan.

5. CUTI:

ELECTION COMMISSION ACT 1957

ELECTION COMMISSION (AMENDMENT OF SECOND SCHEDULE)
REGULATIONS 1981

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 12 of the Election
Commission Act 1957 the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the
following regulations:

1. These regulations may be cited as the Election Commission
(Amendment of Second Schedule) Regulations 1981 and shall be
deemed to have come into force on the 1st July 1980.

2. The Second Schedule to the Election Commission Act 1957
is amended by substituting the following therefor:

4. MEDICAL FACILITIES:

Free outpatient treatment for the Chairman atid members, their
spouses and children but in case of hospitalisation daily ward charges
are payable according to rates chargeable for Division I officers except
where hospitalisation is as a result of injuries sustained in the course
of duty. Where the Chairman or member is a pensioner he may opt for
the medical facilities available to pensioners. "Child" means.any depen-
dant child below 21 years of age of the Chairman or member, or any
dependant child pursuing a first degree in an institution of higher learning
and includes a child who is mentally retarded or physically handicapped
in which case the age limit shall not apply. It shall also include a step-
child or a child adopted under any recognised law or custom.

5. LEAVE:

Thirty days vacation leaye in respect of each completed year.of service
with the Commission shall be granted.

6. MontTHLty Housing ALLOWANCE:

Furnished Class "B" or "C" quarters shall be provided free of charge
or if not living in quarters housing allowance at the following rates shall
be payable—

Chairman                                      $1,250

7. GRATUITY:

A gratuity at the rate of one month's salary or one month's fixed
allowance for each completed year of service and proportionally any
part thereof for every completed month of service shall be paid—

(a) on the expiry of the term of appointment of the member but where
a member is appointed for more than one term he may opt either
to be paid at the end of each term or until he has completed all
the terms (in either case he is only entitled to exemption from
income tax only once); or

(6) to such of his dependants as may be determined by the Yang di-

Pertuan Agong or if there. are no dependants, to his personal rep-
resentative, on his death while holding office.

8. ADVANCE TO PURCHASE MOTOR VEHICLES:
